title: 30-day submission deadline
rule: A claim must be submitted within 30 calendar days of the expense date on the receipt. A claim submitted later than 30 days fails.
text: 30-day submission deadline. A claim must be submitted within 30 calendar days of the expense date on the receipt. A claim submitted later than 30 days fails.

title: Meal cap
rule: Meals during business activities are reimbursed up to SGD 50 per person per meal. An amount above the cap fails.
text: Meal cap. Meals during business activities are reimbursed up to SGD 50 per person per meal. An amount above the cap fails.

title: Client meals
rule: Applies only when the business purpose states that clients attended the meal. A client meal is reimbursed up to SGD 100 per person instead of SGD 50. An amount above SGD 100 per person fails.
text: Client meals. Applies only when the business purpose states that clients attended the meal. A client meal is reimbursed up to SGD 100 per person instead of SGD 50. An amount above SGD 100 per person fails.

title: Alcohol not reimbursable
rule: Alcoholic drinks are not reimbursable under any meal claim. If the receipt contains alcohol lines, the claim fails as submitted; the employee may resubmit without the alcohol lines.
text: Alcohol not reimbursable. Alcoholic drinks are not reimbursable under any meal claim. If the receipt contains alcohol lines, the claim fails as submitted; the employee may resubmit without the alcohol lines.

title: Taxi and ride-hailing cap
rule: Taxi or ride-hailing trips for business are reimbursed up to SGD 80 per trip. An amount above the cap fails, unless the late-night cap in TRANSPORT-002 applies.
text: Taxi and ride-hailing cap. Taxi or ride-hailing trips for business are reimbursed up to SGD 80 per trip. An amount above the cap fails, unless the late-night cap in TRANSPORT-002 applies.

title: Late-night transport
rule: Applies only to trips starting between 23:00 and 06:00 according to the receipt time. For such trips the cap is SGD 120 per trip and replaces the SGD 80 cap in TRANSPORT-001.
text: Late-night transport. Applies only to trips starting between 23:00 and 06:00 according to the receipt time. For such trips the cap is SGD 120 per trip and replaces the SGD 80 cap in TRANSPORT-001.

title: Commuting and private car
rule: Daily commuting between home and the employee's regular office, private-car fuel and parking fines are not reimbursable and fail. A trip between home and a client site for business is not commuting.
text: Commuting and private car. Daily commuting between home and the employee's regular office, private-car fuel and parking fines are not reimbursable and fail. A trip between home and a client site for business is not commuting.

title: Nightly room cap
rule: Hotel rooms on business travel are reimbursed up to SGD 250 per night (room rate plus tax). A claim above the cap fails; exceptions can only be requested from Finance outside this pre-screen.
text: Nightly room cap. Hotel rooms on business travel are reimbursed up to SGD 250 per night (room rate plus tax). A claim above the cap fails; exceptions can only be requested from Finance outside this pre-screen.

title: Personal hotel items
rule: Minibar, in-room movies, spa, laundry under 5 nights and other personal items are not reimbursable. If the receipt contains such lines, the claim fails as submitted; the employee may resubmit without them.
text: Personal hotel items. Minibar, in-room movies, spa, laundry under 5 nights and other personal items are not reimbursable. If the receipt contains such lines, the claim fails as submitted; the employee may resubmit without them.

title: Economy class only
rule: Flights are reimbursed in economy class only. A premium-economy, business-class or first-class fare on the ticket fails.
text: Economy class only. Flights are reimbursed in economy class only. A premium-economy, business-class or first-class fare on the ticket fails.

title: Travel extras
rule: Seat upgrades, extra baggage for personal items, lounge access and personal travel insurance are not reimbursable and fail.
text: Travel extras. Seat upgrades, extra baggage for personal items, lounge access and personal travel insurance are not reimbursable and fail.

title: Foreign currency conversion
rule: A receipt in a foreign currency is converted to SGD at the company rate on the expense date, and all SGD caps are applied to the converted amount.
text: Foreign currency conversion. A receipt in a foreign currency is converted to SGD at the company rate on the expense date, and all SGD caps are applied to the converted amount.

title: Nightly room cap (2024 handbook, archived)
rule: Hotel rooms on business travel are reimbursed up to SGD 300 per night. Superseded by Expense Policy v1.0 in 2026.
text: Nightly room cap (2024 handbook, archived). Hotel rooms on business travel are reimbursed up to SGD 300 per night. Superseded by Expense Policy v1.0 in 2026.
